persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.
bank.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
bank.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
bank.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

messages.text: Could you make a social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach? I like the idea of giving people a little nudge to care for the coast, because it can feel like a small thing that actually matters. For the scene, I’m thinking a friendly seaside illustration, and the graphic should be square. It should have a short, catchy headline, but I’m happy for you to pick the words. I always overthink wording on things like this, so handing that part over is a relief. Please don’t include any dates or signup details.
